::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.callout-important title="Instructor-only guide to Part II (not on the student site)"}
Model milestones and verified numbers for the amniote investigation.

**Stage 1 (structure).** Shape 21,322 x 10. Missingness per trait column:
mass 21.8%, longevity 74.2%, litter/clutch 38.7%, maturity 83.7%, birth
weight 83.4%; the four taxonomy columns and species are complete.
"Missingness is most of the table" is the expected conclusion.

**Stage 2 (unit of analysis).** Classes: Aves 9,802, Reptilia 6,567,
Mammalia 4,953 (sums to 21,322). 465 families; largest is Scincidae
(skinks, 1,351 species), then Gekkonidae (701); 67 families contain a
single species, so family means will mix n=1 and n>1000 groups.

**Stage 3 (validation), the planted findings.** The -999 recode claim
verifies: zero -999 values remain. Genuine defects to find: **4 rows with
female maturity <= 0 days** (impossible), and **35 rows where age at
maturity exceeds maximum longevity** once maturity is converted from days
to years (of 3,126 rows having both). The unit trap is deliberate:
students who compare `female_maturity_d` directly against
`maximum_longevity_y` without converting get nonsense counts. Mass and
longevity have no nonpositive values. Any external species check against
a handbook should pass comfortably.

**Stages 4 and 5 (the classic pair).** Mass vs longevity: 5,122 species
have both (24%). Species-level r of the logged traits is 0.519.
Family-level means of logged values (group by class and family, then
reset_index): **327 families, r = 0.649**. Aggregation genuinely tightens
this relationship, unlike the AVONET case in Part I, because it averages
away species-level eccentrics (naked mole-rats, bats, seabirds). The raw
grams trap: averaging unlogged mass lets single giants drag family means;
the mean of logs is the log of the geometric mean, the right average for
ratio-scale traits.

**Marking guide.** Full credit needs: stated expectations with sources;
a per-column audit reaching the missingness conclusion; the -999 claim
verified rather than trusted; at least one of the two planted defect sets
found with counts; an explicit row-flow for their chosen pair; and a
final caption naming unit, n, transformations, scales, and drops. Reward
students who choose a pair other than mass-longevity and reason about its
much smaller complete-case sample (maturity or birth weight pairs drop to
a few thousand rows at best).
:::
